description: This file defines the Manufacturer entity class for the catalog domain in an e-commerce system, including fields for id, name, code, createdAt, updatedAt, and lifecycle callbacks for persisting and updating timestamps.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: JPA entity class representing a manufacturer in the catalog, with fields for id, name, code, and timestamp metadata, along with lifecycle hooks for automatic timestamp management.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to set createdAt and updatedAt to current timestamp before persisting.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update updatedAt to current timestamp before updating.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the manufacturer and returns the Manufacturer object for chaining.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the manufacturer and returns the Manufacturer object for chaining.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the manufacturer was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the manufacturer was last updated.
